run_benchmark_latency: run the HiSparse JIT kernel benchmark measuring latency of load_cache_to_device_buffer_mla across batch sizes and miss rates
test_benchmark_latency: test the benchmark_latency function with configurable batch sizes, hot buffer sizes, and miss rates
create_hisparse_inputs: create benchmark input tensors including host cache, device buffer, top-k tokens, and LRU slots for HiSparse kernel testing
build_top_k_tokens: build top-k token indices with configurable hits and misses relative to hot buffer size
time_hisparse_kernel: time the load_cache_to_device_buffer_mla kernel with warmup rounds and repeated measurements
